item.title: Top 10 AI use cases on X — Oct 14, 2026
item.description:
Top 10 AI use cases on X (last ~24h, ranked by engagement)
1. **Grok Bot builds its own email UI** — Wanted to read the emails his Grok Bot receives, so he asked Grok Bot to build a clickable email interface for its inbox. @mrfundman · 711 likes, 57 reposts, 82 replies, 88 bookmarks, ~164K views · https://x.com/mrfundman/status/2110198216218067183
2. **100% AI-generated designs that hit 50K views** — Shared designs that got over 50K views in ~2 days, all AI-generated, plus a thread on how they make AI designs that don't look "vibe-coded." @pitus_ · 624 likes, 28 reposts, 19 replies, 1,143 bookmarks, ~36K views · https://x.com/pitus_/status/2110059026818212244
3. **Agent handles a complex overseas tax filing** — Grok Bot gathered documents from his emails and bank accounts, worked out the requirements and filled out the forms; he just reviewed and submitted, saving over $1,000. @Texas_Twins_Dad · 474 likes, 38 reposts, 43 replies, 101 bookmarks, ~1.14M views · https://x.com/Texas_Twins_Dad/status/2110180938948747730
4. **Running a business on one agent stack** — Says Grok Bot replaced Dots and Muse for running his business, with Whop, Vercel/GitHub, Gmail draft-only inbox bot, Notion CRM, X plugin, Cursor cloud agents and a chief-of-staff morning report (~$165/mo). @Av1dlive · 180 likes, 21 reposts, 56 replies, 223 bookmarks, ~208K views · https://x.com/Av1dlive/status/2110329712715182092
5. **Rebuilding a trading terminal via reverse engineering** — Used the open-source REA MCP with Grok Bot to analyze software he owns and rebuild a $36K/year trading terminal as his own 24/7 trading system, backtested with real fees. @eng_khairallah1 · 47 likes, 11 reposts, 20 replies, 60 bookmarks, ~5K views · https://x.com/eng_khairallah1/status/2110103186640109840
6. **Agent managing other agents** — No longer talks to his OpenClaw agents directly; his Grok Bot, "Planchet," manages them for him and does it better. @p_ferragu · 24 likes, 1 repost, 4 replies, ~4.2K views · https://x.com/p_ferragu/status/2110090595687711118
7. **Cleaning up a hacked WordPress site** — Grok Bot found the backdoor, removed malware, restored core files with backups, updated plugins, checked admin accounts and wrote support emails, asking approval at each step; site was back online same day. @testerlabor · 22 likes, 4 reposts, 1 reply, ~1.1K views · https://x.com/testerlabor/status/2110303382468522492
8. **Receipts to the accountant at 12:01 a.m.** — Used AI to send his accountant all receipts one minute after the new quarter began; the accountant asked him to teach other clients (tool not named). @SamuelBeek · 16 likes, 4 replies, ~1.3K views · https://x.com/SamuelBeek/status/2110366765947437077
9. **Household errands with Muse** — Muse merged his and his wife's car insurance onto one carrier (saving $168/month), processed a 7-item clothing return, filled out a PT check-in questionnaire and tracked a two-week overseas wedding trip. @GregProctor · 10 likes, 5 replies, ~825 views · https://x.com/GregProctor/status/2110153347835498882
10. **Agent finds a root exploit chain** — While hardening his next app's sandbox, an AI agent found a two-stage exploit chain that could reach root. @_overment · 10 likes, 3 replies, ~650 views · https://x.com/_overment/status/2110329279175356813
